title: Homecoming Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Try a homecoming at this adorable Seaside cottage surrounded by lush Florida palm trees. Just know that you really can’t feel its refreshing essence until you walk through the door.
description_expanded: Welcome to Homecoming in Seaside, FloridaExperience the ease of a true homecoming at this charming Seaside home, nestled among lush Florida palm trees and thoughtfully designed to help you instantly unwind. Located in one of Seaside’s most desirable areas, this inviting retreat places you just steps from the West Side Pool and only seven homes from Seaside’s iconic private beach access.Light-Filled Living with Indoor–Outdoor FlowStep inside to a bright, airy living space dressed in soft pastel tones and crisp whites that set the tone for coastal comfort. The open-concept living and kitchenette area features a custom built-in dining nook with ample storage, creating a functional yet cozy space for morning coffee, casual meals, or winding down after a day in the sun.Tucked just off the kitchen, a private and spacious open-air deck offers built-in seating and a peaceful escape—ideal for reading in the afternoon shade or enjoying a glass of wine beneath the stars after a day at the beach.Private Upstairs RetreatUpstairs, the serene king bedroom provides a restful sanctuary finished in soothing white tones. Wake up to morning light and step onto the private bedroom balcony overlooking the rear deck and surrounding greenery, creating a tranquil, park-like setting to begin your day in Seaside.Seaside Amenities & Thoughtful TouchesYour stay at Homecoming includes a warm welcome with a thoughtfully curated welcome tote, two beach towels, and a complimentary bottle of wine. Guests also enjoy access to Seaside’s community amenities, including swimming pools, tennis courts, and a fitness center. With the beach, boutique shopping, cafés, and restaurants all within walking distance, Homecoming offers the perfect balance of relaxation and classic Seaside charm.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES460 square feet176 yards | 2-minute walk to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at Natchez Pavilion; Seaside is the largest private residential beach on 30AAcross from the West End poolAdults-only home (children not permitted)Washer & Dryer located in the homePeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayStarter amenities provided1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes (golf carts are considered a vehicle)Golf carts prohibited for non-homeowners; special circumstances and medical needs require a permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001862
